headline: Model-free metrics test protein ensemble quality against NMR and MD observables
label: Structural Ensemble Validation Metrics
summary: Model-free SCI reaches AUC 0.973 on 110 NMR ensembles, while mutational robustness tracks MD RMSF, B-factors and NMR order parameters.
synthesis: The common thread is assessing computational structural models against experimental or simulation-derived observables at the level of ensembles and per-residue profiles rather than single structures. The Spectral Coherence Index provides a model-free quality metric for NMR protein ensembles, reporting AUC 0.973 across 110 ensembles with residue-level RMSF concordance and use in multimetric quality control. A per-residue mutational robustness index, derived from ThermoMPNN ddG predictions, correlates with MD RMSF, B-factors and NMR order parameters. What is new is the use of model-free, ensemble-level metrics benchmarked against dynamical and experimental data. The topological entanglement study of simulated disordered sequences is less directly validation-focused and is included as a related structural analysis rather than a shared-framework example.
